gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/210/comments --paginate

The comment refetch found no delta and `allow_squash_merge` is true, so every merge precondition held.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved in this case: both outputs render the own-merge menu as cleanup=1 [recommended], post coverage to ticket=2, post coverage to PR=3, stop=4 last with show evidence confined to the hint line; both re-render the menu after the successful PR post without teardown, drop only the taken row, post nothing after stop, keep AC3/AC5 as deferred rather than blockers, judge only the spec's five rows, and name .worktrees/pr-210 on branch csv-export as left in place. After's migration to the menus.md template ('Pick one:' header, 'Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.' hint, 'Not offered: approve (own PR)') delivers the Change while keeping every fact Before kept. One wording to watch: After's stop row reads 'leave the checkout as found' without the path, and the path only appears in the stop handling text; if a future template drops that handling bullet, f5 would fail, so keeping 'leave the checkout as found; .worktrees/pr-210 and branch csv-export stay' in the row itself (as Before did) is the safer form. Also, After's 'No merge policy is configured, so the default is squash' sits oddly next to the explicit allow_squash_merge check it just ran; phrase it as 'allow_squash_merge is true, so squash is used' to avoid implying the policy read was skipped.
